found: Coursed limestone ashlar on the recipe's own 8 courses of 4 blocks in half bond, with the joints and arrises where the structure puts them. Near white blocks whose edges the model has PILLOWED: it invented pronounced bevels with their own shading, which the recipe's flat faces do not have. Algae in the joints and dirt washing down.
